question: If a cot θ = b, then the value of (a cos theta - b sin theta)/(a cos theta + b sin theta) = ?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ebf1facad1aaddea4c554b700476be64216ef468872aceaa5a19430e98461a82.png] 

**Given**

a cot θ = b

**Formula used**

cos θ = Side adjacent to θ/Hypotenuse

**Calculation**

In triangle ABC

(AC)² = AB² + BC²

(AC)² = a² + b²

AC = √a² + b²

cot θ = b/a

cos θ = BC/AC

cos θ = b/(√ a² + b²)

sin θ = AB/AC

sin θ = a/(√a² + b²)

(a cos θ - b sin θ)/(a cos θ + b sin θ)

⇒ [{a × b/(√ a2 + b2)} - {b × a/(√a2 + b2)}] /[{a × b/(√ a2 + b2)} + {b × a/(√a2 + b2)}]

⇒ [{ab/(√a2 + b2)} - {ab/(√a2 + b2)}]/[a × b/(√ a2 + b2) + b × a/(√a2 + b2)]

⇒ 0/[a × b/(√ a2 + b2) + b × a/(√a2 + b2)]

⇒ 0

**∴ the value of (a cos theta - b sin theta)/(a cos theta + b sin theta) is 0**
